Beets are round, firm root vegetables with edible, leafy green tops.  Although the
most common root color is bright red, colors may vary 
from deep red to yellow or white, and one variety 
displays concentric rings of red and white.  
When cooked, they have a tender-crisp 
texture and a sweet flavor.
